Ravi S: Draft outbound for customers whose onboarding activation stalled this morning from the provisioning hiccup. Short, clear, include status link and replay offer.

Ravi S: ```Hi <CustomerContact>,

Status: Resolved — provisioning restored.

We experienced a provisioning delay between 07:50–09:12 UTC that affected some Dedicated pool activations. Existing workloads were unaffected.

If you saw a stalled activation, reply with tenant ID and a preferred 2-hour window and we will validate and, if needed, run a manual completion. Our target window for manual validations is 24–48 hours.

Resources: status.redwood.ai (incident #2026-DED-PROV), provisioning dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dedicated/provisioning

We’re sorry for the disruption.

— CS Ops
```
